title: tooling-colibri-qwen-install
description: Install Colibri from the canonical GitHub source and prepare it as an additional local model-engine provider. Also download and checksum the requested Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-Cyber-agentic-imatrix-GGUF IQ4_XS artifact into an isolated model directory if storage permits. Do not expose the Qwen cyber model to autonomous execution, tool-calling, or Astra worker selection yet; keep it quarantined pending separate qualification. Preserve all existing Astra/Codex configuration, especially context_management.experimental_mode=true. Use /home/mediahub or the second disk as appropriate after checking free space. Build/test Colibri with its documented smoke checks. Return exact source SHAs, model file SHA256/size, storage before/after, build/test results, and status.
